DOMAIN_SETTINGS.CONNECT_INTRO: Use a subdomain of your domain (e.g. shop.yourcompany.com) or your root domain itself (e.g. yourcompany.com).
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.SUBDOMAIN_INVALID: Subdomain must be lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens; cannot start or end with a hyphen.
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.APEX_NOTICE:
Heads up: we also serve your store at www.{{domain}} automatically — you'll add a CNAME for it in the final step.
Root domains (apex) can't use a regular CNAME at most DNS providers. Your provider must support ALIAS / ANAME / CNAME flattening (Cloudflare, Route 53, DNSimple all do). If yours doesn't, you can still use the www record on its own and set up a redirect from the apex.
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.VERIFY_INTRO: Add this CNAME record to your DNS provider. Validation usually completes within 5–30 minutes after DNS propagates. You can leave this page and return — your progress is saved.
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.ADD_ALL_RECORDS: Add all records. Continue unlocks only when the overall certificate status is Issued — individual records may show Success before the whole certificate is validated.
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.KEEP_TRAILING_DOT: Keep any trailing dot in the Value if your DNS provider requires it.
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.GENERATING_RECORD: Generating validation record… click Refresh status in a few seconds.
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.AUTO_CHECK_STOPPED: Auto-check stopped after 30 minutes. Click Refresh to keep trying.
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.VALIDATION_FAILED: Validation failed. Re-check the CNAME record above is added exactly as shown, then click Refresh. If the problem persists, contact support.
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.HOW_TO_ADD_CNAME: How to add the CNAME record

DOMAIN_SETTINGS.PROVIDERS_STRIP_DOMAIN: Most providers strip your domain from the Name field. If yours does, paste only the host part shown above.
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.ALMOST_DONE: Almost done — point your domain at our network

DOMAIN_SETTINGS.APPROVED_INTRO: Your certificate is approved. Add the DNS record(s) below so {{host}} resolve to our distribution. Once DNS propagates (usually within an hour) your store will be live at
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.APPROVED_INTRO_WWW: Your certificate is approved. Add the DNS record(s) below so {{host}} and {{www}} resolve to our distribution. Once DNS propagates (usually within an hour) your store will be live at
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.PROVIDER_HINT: Most providers strip your domain from the Name field. If yours does, paste only the host part shown above (everything before .{{domain}}).
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.APEX_P1: The DNS spec forbids CNAME records at the root of a domain. Most providers solve this with ALIAS / ANAME / CNAME flattening records that look like a CNAME but actually resolve to A records. Cloudflare, Route 53 and DNSimple all support this. GoDaddy does not.
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.APEX_A: Option A — GoDaddy Domain Forwarding (simplest, free): redirect {{domain}} to https://www.{{domain}}. Visitors land on the www version, which works via the CNAME above.
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.APEX_B: Option B — move DNS to a provider that supports ALIAS/ANAME: Cloudflare (free) and Route 53 are the most common. Update your nameservers there and add the apex record as ALIAS / ANAME / CNAME flattening pointing at {{cname}}.
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.APEX_C: Option C — skip the apex entirely: add only the www.{{domain}} CNAME above and tell visitors to use the www URL.
DOMAIN_SETTINGS.APEX_FOOT: The www CNAME above always works regardless of which option you pick.
